root_cause.summary: Deploy d-0142 lowered DB_POOL_MAX from 20 to 5; at the 14:02 traffic rise the pool saturated and requests timed out waiting for a connection (503).

evidence.quote: timeout acquiring db connection from pool after 2000ms

ruled_out.why: psp_latency_p95_ms is flat 480-640ms before and during the incident

proposed_action.step: A. Roll back the config change from d-0142 (or PR restoring DB_POOL_MAX=20)

open: Why was the pool reduced (cost tuning)? Confirm with the change author.
